# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty (when Anne was a young girl)  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face. He is described as round-faced and is frequently seen smiling or beaming.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Personality

Billy is stolid, good-natured, stupid, and perpetually smiling, though he suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. He is extremely shy, particularly when it comes to courting, but he possesses good sense and has no bad habits. He is also described as a great worker who can be depended on, though a queer jealous streak cropped out in him after he got married.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v4 c18 P47](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0047)_

## History

Billy Andrews drove Anne Shirley, Diana, and his sister Jane to the White Sands concert in his double-seated buggy, insisting that Anne ride on the front seat beside him. During the evening's supper, Billy decamped in mortal fear of receiving an invitation, though he waited outside with the team to drive the girls home. Having always admired Anne, he later sought to marry her once his father gave him the upper farm in his own name. Too shy to propose himself, he badgered his sister Jane into proposing to Anne on his behalf, offering to wait until she finished college. Following Anne's refusal, Billy did not break his heart and instead married Nettie Blewett, beaming with pride and happiness when he introduced his new bride to the parish church congregation.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
